question: In India, the 'Green Revolution' mainly started in the _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1960's.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Green Revolution** refers to a period of significant **agricultural development** that took place in India during the **1960s and 1970s.**
 
• The main objective of the Green Revolution was to increase agricultural production and productivity by introducing new technologies, high-yielding varieties of **seeds, **and** modern farming practices.**
 
• The Green Revolution played a crucial role in making India **self-sufficient** in food production and reducing its dependence on food imports.
 
• The Green Revolution also led to the emergence of a new class of** wealthy farmers**, who were able to take advantage of the new technologies and farming practices to increase their **income and standard of living.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Norman Borlaug** launched the Green Revolution initiative in the **1960s.**
 
• He is regarded globally as the** "Father of the Green Revolution."**
 
• As a result, he was awarded the **Nobel Peace Prize in 1970 **for his contributions to the creation of **wheat High Yielding Varieties** (HYVs).
